name: AECi — Algolia index drift (Supabase ≠ Algolia)
message:
An Algolia index's object count no longer matches its promoted Supabase rows (AECI-140 daily check, §23.1). Positive drift = the index is missing rows; negative = it holds orphans. Report-only — no auto-remediation; re-run the AECI-138 bulk sync to repair.

Note: notify_no_data fires if the daily 04:00 UTC cron (apps/api/src/scheduled.ts) did not report for 48h — the job itself may be down.

Runbook: https://github.com/the-wbs-project/aec-integrations/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOKS.md#algolia-index-drift
